net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util

Class DataSetWrapper

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util.ResultSetWrapper<DataSet>
      • net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util.DataSetWrapper

  • public class DataSetWrapper
extends ResultSetWrapper<DataSet>

    The Wrapper implementation for wrapping a ResultSet in a DataSet. This class is exposed to allow access to it's PARAMETER_* constants.

    Note that a DataSet cannot be updatable and disconnected at the same time.

    Author:
    Jason Morris

    • Field Detail

      • PARAMETER_DISCONNECTED

        public static final String PARAMETER_DISCONNECTED

        The parameter constant that describes whether a DataSet should be disconnected before it is returned. The value of this parameter should be a Boolean object.

        Setting this parameter to true will result in an optimized implementation of DataSet being returned. The DataSet will first jump to the end of the ResultSet in order to find the length, it will then return to the begining and read in each object. The entire Context will then be disconnected.

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • PARAMETER_UPDATABLE

        public static final String PARAMETER_UPDATABLE

        This parameter determines whether a the returned DataSet objects will be updateable. The value of this parameter should be a Boolean object. If a DataSet is updateable, it's List.add(java.lang.Object), List.addAll(java.util.Collection), List.remove(int) and List.set(int, java.lang.Object) methods will be implemented.

        An updatable DataSet relies on an updatable ResultSet, and thus on the same rules. In general you will need to SELECT from only one table, and include the entire PRIMARY KEY.

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • PARAMETER_CACHE_CLASS

        public static final String PARAMETER_CACHE_CLASS

        This parameter determines the DataSetCache implementation that the returned DataSet objects should use. By default this is a ArrayDataSetCache, but setting the value of the parameter to a Class object that is a valid DataSetCache implementation with a public default constrctor will result in the returned DataSet objects using that implementation instead.

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • getPreferredResultSetConcurrency

        public int getPreferredResultSetConcurrency()
        If the DataSet objects returned by this DataSetWrapper are to be updatable, this method will return ResultSet.CONCUR_UPDATABLE. Otherwise this method returned the default ResultSet.CONCUR_READ_ONLY.
        Overrides:
        getPreferredResultSetConcurrency in class ResultSetWrapper<DataSet>
        Returns:
        the desired concurrency of a ResultSet to be wrapped
        See Also:
        PARAMETER_UPDATABLE

      • getPreferredResultSetType

        public int getPreferredResultSetType()
        When we make an update to the ResultSet we want to see the changes in that ResultSet. This implementation will return ResultSet.TYPE_SCROLL_SENSITIVE for updatable DataSets, and ResultSet.TYPE_SCROLL_INSENSITIVE for read-only DataSets.
        Overrides:
        getPreferredResultSetType in class ResultSetWrapper<DataSet>
        Returns:
        type preferred type of ResultSet that we would like to wrap
